summary: AIFU Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) announcing a $135.0 million non-brokered private placement. The company will issue 45,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $3.00 per share to certain investors, plus warrants for up to 90,000,000 additional Class A shares, half exercisable at 200% and half at 250% of the purchase price. Post-closing shares outstanding total 61,175,748, with the largest investor holding about 56.12% of shares but only 3.19% voting power. Closing expected by end-October 2026. Watch dilution, warrant overhang, and any related ownership or governance changes.
